The Big Switch'' |author=[[Ryder Windham]] |cover artist=[[Jeffery Carlisle]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=Canceled |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=96 |isbn=9780545213608 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline= |series=''[[Star Wars: Adventures in Hyperspace]]'' |preceded by=[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Shinbone Showdown|''Shinbone Showdown'']] |followed by=[[Adventures in Hyperspace: The Last Blade Master|''The Last Blade Master'']] }} '''''Adventures in Hyperspace: The Big Switch''''' was the planned third volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Adventures in Hyperspace]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] young-reader series, which follows the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The book was to be written by [[Ryder Windham]], illustrated by [[Jeffery Carlisle]], and published by [[Scholastic]] on [[September 1]], [[2010]]. Windham completed the manuscript for ''The Big Switch'' before he was informed that the third and [[Adventures in Hyperspace: The Last Blade Master|fourth]] ''Adventures in Hyperspace'' books had been canceled. The completed manuscript is now available on author [[Joseph Bongiorno]]'s fan site, [http://www.starwarstimeline.net/AdventuresinHyperspace.htm The ''Star Wars'' Expanded Universe Timeline].
